name: S.A.L Steel Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, SAL Steel Ltd does manufacturing of Sponge Iron, Ferro Alloys and Power[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
SSL is a Steel, Ferro Alloys and Power Company having operations near Kandla Port in Gujarat. It deals in:
a) Direct Reduced Iron (DRI/Sponge Iron)
b) Ferro Alloys
c) Iron Ore pellets 
d) Various finished steel products
